title: Module ablation on a 100-example Code subset

metrics.PA: Preference adherence percentage; higher is better.
metrics.IA: Instruction adherence percentage; higher is better.
metrics.DR: Distractor rate percentage; lower is better.

sandbox_supplement.caveat: Mocked dry-run structural executability check with fake SDK and runtime stubs; not live cloud-service execution.

notes: Scenario planning has the largest ablation drop in PA and DR.
Draft generation contributes most directly to preference adherence.
Response completion remains important for final answer quality and completeness.
The sandbox supplement shows that high mocked executability does not necessarily imply provider control at runtime.
